//: Copy to proctor.modal.json (gitignored) and run with `proctor run <suite> --config suites/proctor.modal.json`. The same suites run on Modal's sandboxes, on your Modal login (`uvx modal token new`), with nothing on this machine but proctor, nb and uv: no Docker, no podman. A sandbox reaches only public hosts, so every agent arm's model must be on the internet: here the vendors' own APIs, the keys from the environment or ~/.config/proctor/env. A route to a LAN name, a private address or localhost is refused before anything starts, as is a fixture with image.services (Modal cannot confine a task with services). Bare arms (no agent) still run on this machine, so a local model stays usable there. nb and its config are the host's, as in proctor.json; an `agent: nb` arm reads its provider's endpoint from nb's config, which must then be public too. harbor.nb is nb's self-contained linux-x64 publish, copied into each nb task's image. See docs/modal.md.
